meridian-credits-release-agreements: Meridian Credits release agreements for trial-ix3. Scope: all valid quote and total requests, with omitted release selecting the current version and explicit supported releases selecting that version. Current release 2.0: each line credit is floor(charge_cents * 15 / 100); the credit cap is 3000 cents per account_id across all subscriptions; lines are prioritized by descending charge_cents, then ascending line_id using Unicode code-point order; each line receives its uncapped credit up to remaining group cap; totals are sums of assigned credits and charges minus credits. Historical supported release 1.0: each line credit is floor(charge_cents * 10 / 100); the cap is 2400 cents per (account_id, subscription_id); priority is ascending service_on, then ascending line_id; allocation and totals use the same remaining-cap rules. No service date is excluded. Source and approval: Finance agreement recorded in Beads issue trial-ix3, with release 1.0 details preserved by trial-n83 and total behavior by trial-hq0; implementation verified against public release suites and edge-case allocation checks on 2026-09-07.
